proof_attempt_summary: The run established a matched joint minimax risk and finite 90-percent-honest connected-length frontier on the maintained rare-endpoint class, including the rare-mark moment certificate, same-class original-record converse, and both sequence boundaries. Decision and mathematics panels passed after the published mixture theorem was source-attested; the general referee graded subfield with ceiling 6.8 below 7.4 because of restricted scope and noninformative practical certificate constants. tldr: Rare binary endpoints provide less information about outcome regressions than about treatment assignment. The result is the sharp joint precision frontier for a causal risk difference when assignment and normalized outcome risks have Hölder exponent one eighth, treatment probabilities remain positive, and the covariate law is known uniform. The public \(q\) is an envelope scale: every treatment-covariate stratum has event risk comparable to \(q\), with unknown normalized risks in \([1/4,3/4]\). These two-sided bands are novel symmetric maintained triangular-array restrictions. The field-tier deliverable comprises an evaluated minimax mean squared error, a separately established finite 90-percent-honest expected-length frontier, original-record procedures, and same-class converses at every sample size and public rarity scale. Relative consistency and the boundary for known-propensity order follow from the matched frontier. The evaluated joint frontier and sequence conclusions are proved.
gap: The fixed-risk scalar-functional correction and mixture results establish the rough scalar benchmark under their stated conditions. They do not furnish the complete joint public-rarity certificate on this observation class. Balzer et al. motivates rare absolute-risk questions and supplies bounded-mean rTMLE, rather than the maintained scale-proportional two-sided risk bands.
fill: Uniform rare-mark contraction bounds, separate-resolution reciprocal corrections, and legal full-mark mixtures provide a concrete route to an evaluated risk frontier and finite honest-length converse. The field-tier contribution requires the joint phase separation between event information and rough adjustment, with matching necessity. The prospective consumer needs relative resolution at the public endpoint scale.
